verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a deployment PaaS, but the evidence describes Vercel only as a managed cloud platform, with no documented self-hosted distribution of the platform itself. The Apache-2.0 vercel/vercel repo covers only the CLI and framework builders. The Build Output API spec and the eve framework running locally are adjacent building blocks, not a way to self-host Vercel. Community posts about moving to self-hosted alternatives such as Dokploy point the same way.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
